LESSON: SIGN READING 4.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Sign Reading 4.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 4.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we tell what the story is about?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 4.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: Learner’s ability to think creatively and imaginatively as they make connections between the story and their

experiences.

● Communication and Collaboration: Skill of speaking or signing is enhanced as learner makes predictions on the outcome of the story.

Values:
Respect: Learner appreciates the diverse opinions from others

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skill: Effective communication as learner answers direct and indirect questions correctly.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learner is able to relate the skill of sign reading to their learning in Kenya Sign Language Activities, Mathematical Activities, and Environmental

Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Adapted course book, class readers, course books, flash cards, recording devices e.g tablets, mobile phone, dictionary, internet, signed audio-visual
